title: Dataset Engine — Exam Configuration Schema
description: Every exam processed by this engine must provide a JSON file conforming to this schema. The engine reads it at runtime and derives all exam-specific behavior from it.

exam_id.description: Unique lowercase slug. Used as folder name and output file prefix. Example: 'ucr26'

exam_name.description: Human-readable full name of the exam. Example: 'UCR 2026 Admissions Exam'

language.description: ISO 639-1 two-letter language code for the exam content. Example: 'es', 'en'

skill_taxonomy.description: Map of skill IDs to their definitions. Each key is a skill identifier (e.g., H1, H2). H1 is reserved for the cognitive load dimension if present.

type.description: cognitive_load: cross-cutting dimension (like H1). skill: evaluable competency.

macro_area.description: Which macro area this skill belongs to. Must match an id in macro_areas[].

macro_areas.description: Groupings of skills into broad assessment domains.

segments.description: Target counts and properties for each output segment.

explanation_layer.description: Whether this segment gets the F2 explanation layer.

difficulty_levels.description: Map of difficulty level IDs to their definitions.

explanation_rules.description: Rules that govern how explanation pairs are generated and validated.

correct_line1_pattern.description: Regex string for explanation_correct line 1 validation. Applied as new RegExp(...).

incorrect_line1_prefix.description: Required prefix for explanation_incorrect_common line 1. Example: 'Error:'

incorrect_line2_prefix.description: Required prefix for explanation_incorrect_common line 2. Example: 'Corrección:'

forbidden_words.description: Words that must not appear in generated explanation text.

forbidden_replacements.description: Map of forbidden_word → replacement_word used by the generation cleaner.

prohibited_substrings.description: Multi-word phrases that must not appear anywhere in output (case-insensitive).

min_line_length.description: Minimum character length per explanation line.

max_line_length.description: Maximum character length per explanation line.

explanation_fallbacks.description: Fallback explanation text used by the generator when the item's justification fields are too short or empty. Keyed by skill ID matching skill_taxonomy.

validation_thresholds.description: Quality gates for the generation pipeline (from execution_config.json).

output.description: Output filenames relative to the exam folder. Paths are resolved as: exam_dir/03_item_production/<dataset_filename> and exam_dir/04_validation/<explanations_filename>.
